item.title: London to Bruges 2025: Riding for a Cause, Powered by Data
item.description: What has 40 wheels, 20 hearts, and one powerful mission? A team of dedicated riders from Cisco, Splunk, Adarma, and RiverSafe embarking on a 400km ride from London to Bruges — all to raise awareness and funds for Prostate Cancer Research. Follow their journey filled with determination, data, and heart.
